name: units-atlas-01-readout-inventory
title: Inventory of every unit-bearing readout across the E. coli sim
question:
What quantities does the baseline E. coli simulation expose on its listener
ports, in what units, and over what magnitude ranges? Grouped by physical
dimension as a navigable reference.

report.title: Units Atlas — every unit-bearing readout across the E. coli sim
report.objective:
Catalog every unit-bearing readout the baseline composite declares on its
listener/process ports, grouped by physical dimension, as a navigable
reference that pairs with the units-on-axes feature (which labels plot axes
from these same declared port-schema units).
report.summary:
The atlas resolves units live from the typed port schema
(`v2ecoli.library.units_resolver.build_units_index`) — no run needed — and
finds 27 unit-bearing readouts across six physical dimensions:
concentration (13, mostly mM/uM growth-limit and FBA targets), mass (4, fg),
time (3, s), count (2), rate (1, 1/s), plus 4 in "other" (flux-like units
such as g*s/L and mmol/g/h). Each row lists the observable's dotted path and
its declared unit; example magnitudes + ranges populate when a baseline run
is sampled. The embedded figure is the rendered catalog.
caveats: Descriptive reference, not a hypothesis test — no pass/fail gate.
Magnitude columns are blank until a baseline parquet run is sampled; the units + paths are schema-derived and always present.
Coverage is limited to process classes the index can introspect; a few config-dependent readouts may be absent (logged, not silently dropped).
